name: Fairmont Ambassador Seoul
positioning: Richard Rogers-designed city hotel on Yeouido, in the Parc1 complex beside the Han River
best_for: Travelers who want a Han River base on Yeouido with metro access
Guests who want dining with Han River views

facts.text: The hotel was designed by architect Richard Rogers.
The hotel is in the Parc1 complex in Seoul.
The hotel is on Yeouido, with outdoor activities along the Han River at Yeouido Hangang Park.
The hotel is close to The Hyundai Seoul, which the hotel describes as the capital's largest luxury department store.
The hotel connects to the city's metro network.
Spectrum offers international cuisines and interactive live cooking stations.
Fairmont Gold rooms are on the upper floors and include Fairmont Gold Lounge access.
The hotel has a spa, ESPA at Fairmont, which offers luxury treatments.
The hotel has a fitness facility called Fairmont FIT.
The hotel offers an airport shuttle service, arranged by contacting the hotel.

highlights.text: Mariposa serves modern European-inspired cuisine with views of the Han River and the Seoul skyline.
The Penthouse 3 Bedroom Suite is located on the highest floor.
The hotel's official character, Sudari, is inspired by the endangered otters living along the Han River beside the hotel.
The Signature 1 Bedroom Suite Panorama View has panoramic views of the Yeouido cityscape and a separate living area and bedroom.

considerations.text: Swimming pool improvement works, replacing the pool floor marble, run November 16 to 20, 2026.
WhataHotel notes the business district location may be quieter on weekends.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
